newsitem.title: USA: Veeco to buy Wyko, Sony unit.
newsitem.headline: Veeco to buy Wyko, Sony unit.

text.p: Veeco Instruments Inc said on Tuesday it agreed to buy Wyko Corp of Tucson, Ariz., for three million shares of Veeco stock.
Veeco also said it signed a memorandum of understanding to buy Materials Research Corp's Media and Magnetic Applications division for cash plus the assumption of certain liabilities.
Precise terms of the Materials Research deal were not disclosed.

Veeco makes precision ion beam systems and surface metrology equipment for the microelectronics industry. Wyko makes instruments used by manufacturers of hard disks, semiconductors and other high-tech products.

The media and magnetic applications division Veeco proposes to buy from Materials Research is developing a line of physical vapor deposition sputtering equipment used by the semiconductor and magnetics industries.
Materials Research, of Orangeburg, N.Y., is a wholly owned unit of Sony Corp.

Also Tuesday, Veeco was initiated as a near and long-term buy by Merrill Lynch, and raised to a strong buy from a buy by Alex. Brown. Veeco shares were trading at 31-1/4 at midday, up 2-1/4 on the day and equaling their 52-week high.
